kind: must-be-deep
depth: deep
reason: deep-policy
-- base/main.tf --
locals {
  actions = ["sqs:SendMessage"]
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name   = "q"
  policy = jsonencode({ Statement = [{ Action = local.actions }] })
}
-- head/main.tf --
locals {
  actions = ["sqs:SendMessage", "sqs:ReceiveMessage"]
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name   = "q"
  policy = jsonencode({ Statement = [{ Action = local.actions }] })
}
